context: You are exploring a ruined area strewn with debris and odd oddments; when you click a trap on the ground it is broken and inert, prompting the player line "Not much use anymore." Earlier in the zone a failed disarm attempt has already warned you that active traps exist, so this interaction serves to mark this particular device as harmless. Nearby interactions in the same scene may include small holes that yield trash (like a bone), an abandoned pot that might have been used for brewing, a broken Moonlantern recovered from a corpse, or a dead bird — but those are separate objects and outcomes. This summary explains only that the trap itself is useless and other items you might inspect are unrelated.
